purpose: Evaluate one new full-gallery generative candidate, hierarchical_poisson, intended to improve raw recall and OCF through DCT16 image-prior shrinkage of raw-count empirical Poisson rates plus unlabeled target-marginal calibration. This is not v5 top-32 reranking or small-weight score fusion. Development reuse is not pristine validation and is not a Kaggle result.
scope: Create implementation files only under test/51_hierarchical_poisson. Do not modify src, other experiments, or Git history. Experiment 48 code and development outputs are read-only; its completed production_recipe development result is used only as the required comparator, never to design candidate parameters. Do not depend on experiments 49 or 50.

data.raw_counts: Shared unnormalized 25ms uint16 trial counts; no log transform or session normalization enters the generative rates or scores.
data.gallery: Public pictures.npy, loaded read-only and binarized as (pictures >= 128).astype(float32) for both DCT16 and official OCF.

task2.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task2', seed=42, validation_session=s) for s in session1, session2, session3, in that order
task2.training: For each mouse independently, only train_trials from the other three complete sessions. No target-session trial enters prior fitting, empirical rates, or source marginal.
task2.validation: The entire held-out target session supplies unlabeled single-trial counts for target_marginal. Local GT is used only after rate construction to simulate official group_ptr and select/score evaluation rows.

task3.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task3', seed=s) for s in 20261126 and 20261127, in that order
task3.training: For each mouse independently, each of four blocks has exactly three disjoint training repeats per glyph. Fit one shared image prior from all four blocks but retain a separate empirical posterior and gain for every block.
task3.validation: Exactly one disjoint validation single trial per glyph per block. All 2748 unlabeled validation singles in each block determine that block's target_marginal; no repeat aggregation.

arm.name: hierarchical_poisson
arm.epoch_field_adapter: Result rows carry epoch=1 solely because experiment 48 aggregate_rows includes epoch in its keys. It denotes the single deterministic evaluation, not optimization or checkpoint selection.

image_prior.encoding: src.ridge.dct_encode(binary_pictures, 16), producing 256 fixed DCT coefficients per glyph.
image_prior.task2_rows: For each of three training sessions independently, aggregate that session's four train repeats by target using an arithmetic raw-count mean; one row per target, exactly 3*2748 rows.
image_prior.task3_rows: For each of four training blocks independently, average that block's three train repeats by target in raw-count space; one row per target, exactly 4*2748 rows.
image_prior.prediction: prior_rate = maximum(expm1(predicted_log1p_rate), 1e-4), with shape 2748 x n_features.

empirical_posterior.task2: Pool raw training single-trial count sums by target over all three training sessions. n=12 for every glyph; empirical_rate=sum_train_counts/12.
empirical_posterior.task3: Within each block independently, sum its three raw training single trials by target. n=3 for every glyph; never pool the four block empirical rates or posteriors.

unlabeled_target_calibration.source_marginal: Overall feature-wise arithmetic mean of corresponding raw training single trials: all three Task2 training sessions, or each Task3 block separately.
unlabeled_target_calibration.target_marginal: Overall feature-wise arithmetic mean of all raw unlabeled validation single trials: the whole Task2 held-out session, or each Task3 block's 2748 validation trials independently. Targets/labels are not inputs.

poisson_scoring.device: CUDA float32 torch.mm for real development; CPU float32 is permitted only for synthetic smoke.
poisson_scoring.task2: Use local GT only to simulate official group_ptr: sum each target's four raw repeats to obtain 2748 query rows. For every row and all 2748 classes, score = sum_counts @ log(calibrated_rate).T - 4*calibrated_rate.sum(axis=1).
poisson_scoring.task3: For every unmerged validation single row and all 2748 classes in each block, score = x @ log(calibrated_rate_for_this_block).T - calibrated_rate_for_this_block.sum(axis=1). Repeat aggregation is prohibited.
poisson_scoring.constant: Omit log factorial and every other class-independent constant.
poisson_scoring.candidate_matrix: Materialize only two-dimensional query-by-class matrices in query batches, with the complete 2748-class axis. Never construct a query-by-class-by-feature three-dimensional tensor.
poisson_scoring.score_modification: None: no v5 logits, top-32 restriction/reranking, fusion, temperature, or learned weights.

evaluation.implementation: Import and call experiment 48 OcfPairCache and evaluate_logits unchanged; gallery is binary {0,1} float32 from pictures >= 128.
evaluation.rows: After full-candidate scoring, select the same sorted 256 development targets. Task2 evaluates one 256 x 2748 matrix per mouse-fold; Task3 evaluates one 256 x 2748 matrix per block.
evaluation.hungarian: Experiment 48 evaluate_logits/src.retrieval.unique_assignment independently on every 256 x 2748 raw Poisson score matrix, with all candidate columns available.
evaluation.aggregation: Import and call experiment 48's corrected aggregate_rows unchanged: block rows -> mouse_fold -> mouse/fold/macro, propagating n_evaluation_rows from n_rows only at mouse_fold and thereafter from n_evaluation_rows.
evaluation.ocf_scale: Native official score scale; the +3 gate is an absolute assigned_final_ocf difference.

reference48.comparator: production_recipe at its own already-selected best macro epoch independently in Task2 and Task3; do not retrain or re-select it.
reference48.integrity: Before cache/CUDA access, load both files, hash both, verify selection.development_results_sha256 equals the actual results SHA256, verify matching preregistration hashes and development subset, and independently verify the selected production epoch against experiment 48 macro history.
reference48.parameter_independence: No candidate constant, fold, or model choice is derived from experiments 48, 49, or 50 metrics. The experiment 48 comparator is read only when a real run is explicitly requested, never during synthetic smoke.

advancement_gate.comparison: hierarchical_poisson minus experiment 48 production_recipe at production's own selected epoch, independently within each task; the candidate has no epoch selection.
advancement_gate.per_mouse: Both mouse-level assigned_final_ocf deltas must be >= 0 in each task.
advancement_gate.folds: Fold-level assigned_final_ocf deltas averaged over the two mice must be nonnegative for at least 2/3 Task2 folds and 2/2 Task3 folds.
advancement_gate.outcome: All per-task gates must pass for overall advance=true. Otherwise stop with no alternate model, alpha, pseudo-count, gain clip, or other hyperparameter search. Passing development still requires separately authorized pristine/final validation, which this experiment never performs.

audits.per_mouse_fold: Record train/validation trial roles and counts, prior-row counts, n per glyph, exact source and unlabeled target marginal counts, label-isolation statements, and shape/SHA256/min/mean/max for empirical_rate, image prior, posterior, unclipped/clipped gain, calibrated rate, and marginals. Do not dump large rate matrices into JSON.
audits.development_status: Every real output explicitly states development reuse only, not pristine validation, and not a Kaggle result.

prohibited: Task2 session4 validation or final evaluation
final or heldout metrics for model or parameter selection
target validation labels in prior, posterior, source marginal, target marginal, or gain construction
v5 top-32 reranking or score fusion
